definitions.content: speed meter emitting pulsed or modulated radiation and detecting the range (distance) from the radiation reflected by objects

notes.content: 2D and 3D laser scanners and hand-held LIDAR speed meters are examples belonging to this category. LIDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) is a remote sensing method that determines target range and speed based on the time-of-flight of laser light pulses reflected off a target.
